start.text: Luna the unicorn wakes up on a sunny morning. Where should she go today?

a.text: In the forest, a little squirrel waves hello. 'Will you play with me today?'

b.text: At the beach, Luna finds a little sailboat. The sea sparkles!

aa.text: Together they find a mountain of acorns! The squirrel is so thankful. What now?

ab.text: Luna is the best hider in the forest! All the animals want more fun.

ba.text: A friendly whale swims up and sprays a sparkly hello! Far away on the beach, a little bonfire starts to glow.

bb.text: The sandcastle is magnificent, and a little crab wants to be its king!

end_party.text: The whole forest comes to Luna's acorn party! What a wonderful day. The End!

end_rainbow.text: What a forest adventure! Luna slides all the way home on a rainbow. Sweet dreams, Luna! The End!

end_crown.text: The animals weave Luna a crown of daisies — Hide-and-Seek Champion of the whole forest! The End!

end_pearl.text: The whale shows Luna a glowing pearl — a gift for her bravery! The End!

end_crab.text: King Crab rules the grandest sandcastle on the beach. Long live the king! The End!

end_bonfire.text: Luna hurries to the glowing bonfire on the twinkly beach, and everyone dances until the stars come out. The End!

start.text: Pip the puppy found a treasure map! Where does the trail begin?

a.text: Sniff sniff! The trail leads through the sunflowers. Pip hears a sound...

b.text: The map shows the park! Where should Pip look first?

aa.text: Pip digs up a mysterious little chest! It rattles. Should he...

ab.text: The sound was three tiny kittens, peeking out of an old watering can! 'Mew! Mew! We're hungry and a little lost.'

choices.label: Dig up the treasure to share 🦴

ba.text: Wheee! At the bottom waits a shiny golden ball — the map's treasure! And it's rolling away!

bb.text: The sun is setting at the old oak. Inside lives a family of glowing fireflies! They swirl around Pip.

end_biscuits.text: The chest is full of golden biscuits! Best treasure a puppy ever found. The End!

end_share.text: Pip opens the chest and shares the biscuits with everyone. Sharing is the best treasure! The End!

end_kittens.text: Pip leads the kittens safely home before dark. Three sleepy thank-you mews! The End!

end_ball.text: Pip catches the golden ball with a super jump! Champion Pip! The End!

end_game.text: Pip and his friends play until sunset. A treasure of a day! The End!

end_fireflies.text: The fireflies lead Pip to a secret glowing garden — right where X marks the spot! Magic! The End!

start.text: Milo must fetch grandma's key from the old house on the hill. The wind whispers his name...

scare.reveal: Just an old crow! It was sleeping in the bush. Keep going, Milo...

a.text: The hallway is dark and TOO quiet. Something is scratching inside the closet... it knows Milo is there.

scare.reveal: A soggy raccoon! 'Sorry,' he sniffles, 'I was cold.' He points upstairs with his tail.

b.text: In the garden, the fog moves like it's alive. The cellar door groans open by itself. Something breathes down there.

scare.reveal: Three hedgehogs in one scarf! They were hiding from the storm. The smallest one giggles.

aa.text: Upstairs, a music box plays all by itself... and the door at the end of the hall RATTLES. Then a soft voice purrs: 'Milo? Is that you, little one?' It's Great-Grandcat!

ab.text: In the library the whispers are LOUD now. The big chair creaks. Something's tail twitches behind it... and a kind voice hoots: 'Who-o-o wants a story?'

scare.reveal: The whisperers are owls! It's their midnight book club. 'Shhh,' says the owl, smiling.

ba.text: The cellar glows with a hundred little jam jars. A HUGE monster shadow rises on the wall! But look closer... it's a teeny-tiny mouse in a chef's hat, holding jam toast.

scare.reveal: The giant monster is... a tiny chef mouse and his candle! He offers Milo blackberry jam.

bb.text: The greenhouse plants sway... but there is no wind. And that tall white shape was NOT there before. It giggles a friendly little giggle. Could it be... a Garden Phantom?

scare.reveal: A heron in a bedsheet! 'I am the Garden Phantom!' she announces proudly. Nobody is scared.

end_family.text: Milo and Great-Grandcat share midnight tea and stories until the storm passes. And peeking out of the teapot — grandma's key! The End!

end_key.text: Milo asked so nicely that his new friend fetched grandma's key! And as he leaves... something in the window waves goodbye. The End?

end_owls.text: Milo stays for owl story time. The spooky house isn't spooky at all — just full of readers. And Grandpa Owl's bookmark? It's grandma's key! The End!

end_feast.text: A midnight jam feast with Chef Mouse! Milo's whiskers are sticky with strawberry. And Chef Mouse knows JUST where grandma's key is. The End!

end_phantom.text: The Garden Phantom leads a midnight parade — hedgehogs in a line! — and Milo is the lantern-bearer. And look what the Phantom found in the flowers: grandma's key! The End!

start.text: It's Mo's first day at Scare School — where little monsters learn to be scary. Mo is NOT scary. Yet.

scare.reveal: RAAH! Hee hee! 'Thorry,' lisps Fangsley through his teeth. 'Firtht-day tradition!'

a.text: In Scaring Class, Principal Growlbert teaches BOO 101. Mo's scary face just looks... adorable. The supply closet wobbles — someone tiny in there is giggling too!

scare.reveal: BLOB! Blobbina jiggles so hard everyone falls off their chairs laughing. 'Ten points!' says the Principal.

b.text: Lunch is worm spaghetti and eyeball pudding (it's just grapes). Something under the lunch counter is giggling...

scare.reveal: Sir Stretch was folded under there ALL MORNING waiting! 'Worth it,' he says, un-crumpling.

aa.text: The Scary Talent Show! Every monster did a big scare. Now it's Mo's turn. The gym goes silent... the curtain behind Mo ripples.

ab.text: Blobbina pulls Mo down the hall to the Mirror Room. Her secret: 'Being scary is just being YOU — your way!' The funhouse mirror behind them darkens...

scare.reveal: It's just Principal Growlbert on juice break! His shadow is scarier than he is. 'Carry on!'

ba.text: Mo wins the noodle-arm contest by becoming the ball! But the pudding cart is rolling away by itself...

scare.reveal: Fangsley was IN the pudding! 'Thith ith the betht day of my life,' he says, dripping.

bb.text: The Twins can't agree whose scare is best. They ask Mo to judge. Behind them, the trash can tiptoes away...

scare.reveal: Trash-can Blobbina! Both Twin heads agree for the FIRST TIME EVER: that was the best scare.

end_boo.text: At the big talent show, Mo whispers the tiniest 'boo' ever... and the whole school tumbles over laughing! The giggly closet ghost giggles loudest of all. Scariest Sound winner: MO! The End!

end_team.text: Scares are better together! When the mess is tidied and the cheering starts, the whole school parades to the auditorium and piles onto the big stage. Mo and the class take a bow. Best first day ever. The End!

end_growl.text: Mo sneaks up and — BOO! Principal Growlbert jumps so high his juice goes flying! He laughs until his glasses fog up. Instant legend. The End!

end_pudding.text: CRASH! SPLAT! Pudding flies EVERYWHERE — it's the Great Pudding Party of Scare School! Even the lunch pot is laughing. The End!

start.text: Luna found a tiny floating house with two magic doors! The red sun door hums with warm light. The blue moon door twinkles with tiny stars. Which door should Luna open?

a.text: Behind the red door is a garden in the clouds! A golden slide curls down the hill, and a giant bouncy mushroom goes boing... boing... Where should Luna play?

b.text: Behind the blue door is a night garden full of stars! A firefly boat bobs on the pond, and a silver moon swing sways from a star. What should Luna ride?

aa.text: Wheee! The slide lands in a candy-cloud valley. A rainbow ferris wheel spins slowly, and a cozy cloud cottage puffs warm little smoke rings. Where to now?

ab.text: Boing! Luna bounces all the way up to a treetop village. A flaggy rope bridge leads to a lantern party, and a little smiling cloud floats up beside her. What should Luna do?

ba.text: The firefly boat sails to Star Island, where baby stars snore tiny sparkly snores. There's a soft moonbeam nest, and a little striped lighthouse. Where should Luna go?

bb.text: The swing carries Luna to a balcony on the moon! A big brass telescope peeks at the stars, and a curly silver slide swooshes all the way home. What should Luna pick?

end_party.text: Round and round Luna rides the rainbow wheel, then dances all evening with the cloud sheep and star bunnies. Best. Door. Ever! The End!

end_cozy.text: Warm cocoa, marshmallows, and stories by the fire with Granny Sheep. Luna purrs like a kitten. The End!

end_stars.text: The baby stars snuggle Luna like a sparkly blanket. Shhh... goodnight, Luna. The End!

end_flight.text: The friendly cloud flies Luna all the way home, loop-de-loop! 'Same time tomorrow?' it whispers. The End!

end_dizzy.text: Whoa — the lighthouse lamp is SO bright! Luna goes all dizzy and slides right back down to the boat. Home early, blinking little stars. Oopsie ending!

end_slip.text: Wheee — TOO fast! The slippery silver slide plops Luna SPLAT into a puddle. Muddy mane! Straight home for a bath. Oopsie ending!

end_party_treetop.text: Across the bridge, the treetop party is ON! Lanterns, balloons, and dancing till the stars peek out. Best. Bridge. Ever! The End!

end_stars_moon.text: Through the telescope Luna spots... baby stars! They fly right up to snuggle her on the moon balcony. Goodnight, little stars. The End!

start.text: Pip found a treasure map! X marks the spot. The trail splits: a sparkly crystal cave in the cliff, or a wobbly rope bridge over the lagoon. Which way, Pip?

a.text: Inside, glowworms light the cave like tiny lanterns. A crystal tunnel sparkles purple and pink, and a little red row boat rocks on an underground stream. Which way to the treasure?

b.text: The jungle is buzzing and green! A rope ladder climbs a tall lookout palm, and a fat jungle vine swings over the gully. How should Pip go?

aa.text: A secret chamber! A golden door with a crab-shaped lock... and a shimmery waterfall hiding something sparkly. Where's the treasure, Pip?

ab.text: The stream opens into a secret glowing lagoon! A tiny lighthouse blinks hello — there's a crab waving! And over there, a geyser burps giant rainbow bubbles. Where to?

ba.text: From the top, Pip sees everything — even an old shipwreck on the beach! A zipline zooms right to it. And... is that a coconut catapult? Choose, Pip!

bb.text: Wheee! Pip lands on a real pirate ship! The captain's wheel has a paw print on it... and a parrot in a tiny hat squawks 'Pieces of kibble! Pieces of kibble!' What should Pip try?

end_splash.text: SPLASH! Best swim ever, with bubbles and new friends. Maybe THIS was the real treasure. (Nah — but it's close!) The End!

end_friends.text: Crab makes sandwiches, Parrot tells pirate jokes, and Whale pops up to say hello. Treasure friends forever! The End!

end_soggy.text: SPLOOSH! Behind the waterfall is... just MORE water. Pip is soaked to the whiskers and the map went all drippy. Home for a warm towel. Oopsie ending!

end_boing.text: BOING! The coconut catapult flings Pip aaaall the way back to the start of the beach. Sandy bottom. Zero treasure. Oopsie ending!

end_chest_cave.text: The crab door swings open — and there it is! A chest of golden bones and squeaky toys, deep in the sparkly cave. X marks the spot! The End!

end_chest_wreck.text: Right there on the pirate ship — the treasure chest! Golden bones, squeaky toys, and a cheering parrot. X marks the spot! The End!
